requirements.statement: Shoppers can browse the product catalog

criteria.must: The catalog page lists available products
Each listed product shows at least its name, image, and price

requirements.statement: Shoppers can view detailed information about a product before buying

criteria.must: Opening a product from the catalog shows a detail view with photos, description, price, and availability

requirements.statement: Shoppers can search or filter products by category

criteria.must: Filtering by a category shows only products in that category
Searching by keyword returns matching products

requirements.statement: Shoppers can add products to a cart

criteria.must: Adding a product from the catalog or detail view increases the cart's item count
The cart shows the added product with its quantity and price

requirements.statement: Shoppers can update quantities or remove items from the cart

criteria.must: Changing an item's quantity in the cart updates the line subtotal and cart total
Removing an item from the cart deletes it from the cart and updates the total

requirements.statement: Shoppers can check out as a guest without creating an account

criteria.must: A shopper who is not signed in can complete checkout by supplying contact and payment details
Guest checkout never prompts for account creation or sign-in as a required step

requirements.statement: Shoppers can pay for their order with a card

criteria.must: Checkout collects card payment details and submits them for payment capture
A successful payment results in a placed order
A declined payment blocks order placement and shows an error

requirements.statement: Shoppers receive an email confirmation after checkout

criteria.must: Completing checkout triggers a confirmation email to the address supplied at checkout

requirements.statement: Shoppers can sign in to an account to view past orders

criteria.must: A shopper can sign in using the platform's sign-in flow
A signed-in shopper can view a list of their own past orders

requirements.statement: Shoppers can view the status of their order

criteria.must: An order detail view shows its current fulfillment status (e.g. packed, shipped, delivered)

requirements.statement: Store Admin can sign in securely to manage the store

criteria.must: An admin can sign in via the platform's sign-in flow to reach the admin console
A caller without an admin role cannot access admin-only actions

requirements.statement: Store Admin can create, edit, and remove products in the catalog

criteria.must: The admin can create a new product that then appears in the catalog
The admin can edit an existing product's details and see the change reflected
The admin can remove a product and it no longer appears in the catalog

requirements.statement: Store Admin can manage inventory levels so shoppers cannot order out-of-stock items

criteria.must: The admin can update a product's stock quantity
A shopper cannot add a product to the cart, or complete checkout, when its stock quantity is zero

requirements.statement: Store Admin can view incoming orders to fulfill them

criteria.must: The admin can view a list of all placed orders across shoppers

requirements.statement: Store Admin can update an order's fulfillment status

criteria.must: The admin can change an order's status (e.g. to packed, shipped, or delivered)
The updated status is visible to the shopper viewing that order
